description: This is a Java interface named Agenda defining methods related to managing show schedules and entities such as Espetaculo (show/event) and Sessao (session).

classes.name: Agenda
classes.description: Interface defining methods for managing and querying shows and sessions.

methods.name: espetaculos
methods.description: Returns a list of all shows (Espetaculos).

methods.name: proximasSessoes
methods.description: Retrieves upcoming sessions (Sessoes) up to a maximum limit.

methods.name: sessao
methods.description: Fetches a specific session (Sessao) by its ID.

methods.name: espetaculo
methods.description: Fetches a specific show (Espetaculo) by its ID.
